title: Bienvenidos a Miami
summary:
Bienvenidos a Miami
This past week members of the energy industry convened for the 26 th Annual Fuel Oil/Energy Buyers' Conference in Miami Beach, Florida. The topics discussed ranged from macro drivers for worldwide energy consumption to the role of fuel oil in the energy mix. The variety of companies that were in attendance stimulated interesting discussions, both in the conference room and at the dinner table.
